core_meaning.primary_meaning: Golnoush corresponds to the Persian form گلنوش and is glossed in this record as “Flower of nectar.” The lexical gloss describes the word-form; Qur’anic occurrence, religious recommendation, popularity, and a name-bearer’s character are separate claims and are not established by this gloss alone.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Golnoush corresponds to the Persian form گلنوش (Persian گلنوش (golnush) 'flower of nectar', from گل + نوش 'nectar'). Its core sense is flower of nectar, sweet flower. Golnoush is the Persian گلنوش (golnush) — گل 'flower' + نوش 'nectar' — 'flower of nectar, sweet flower', a feminine name. The source supplied only Latin strings and mislabelled it 'Arabic' while glossing it 'golden light'; the compound reading is recorded at medium confidence.
